issues.description: The problem specification and UML require a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int, but the solution implementation defines getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) with a boolean parameter. This parameter mismatch creates confusion about the intended API and forces different implementations/usages (e.g., the solution's getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() calls getTotalNumberOfStudents(true)). Students following the problem statement will implement a no-arg method while the solution shows a different signature, which is an unintended inconsistency across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification by changing the solution's method signature to public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() (no parameters) and update all internal calls (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use the no-arg method. Alternatively, if the boolean parameter is intentional, update the problem statement, UML diagram, and template TODO comments to specify getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests).
